**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

This life is not the Temple but the Gate
Where men secure of entrance watch and wait
		[Aubrey de Vere](../persons.html#2259)

Dear [Mrs Trebeck](../persons.html#1416)

I am afraid this is too late but I cannot help sending it

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
They are the end of his sonnet in answer to ‘A life worth living[‘]

[^1]: With envelope addressed to Mrs Trebeck/ Southwell/ Notts and postmarked Winchester 11 July 1892.

Mary Trebeck edited The Blue Birthday Book: Proverbs, Maxims and Quotations for Every Day of the Year (London: Gardner, Darton 1898).
